evidence.meaning: Catalogue request defaults use list_rows and goods_category_id; zero selects all categories.
Category selection resets pagination and sets an integer category identifier.
Result code 100 expires authentication; code 110 means source access has become unavailable.
The product detail endpoint receives an integer id field.
The bundled Axios default transform serializes object request bodies as JSON. Its header setter only fills an absent header, so the app's explicitly configured form Content-Type remains unchanged.
The embedded source client reads the account profile using GET with same-origin browser cookies. The Vue application wrapper separately uses POST.

Official documentation entry observed in the source UI; on 2026-10-25 it redirects with HTTP 301 to the generic workspace.apipost.net homepage, so the product OpenAPI authentication contract remains unverified.
